question: Should the `.github` code owner approve and merge this canonical pull request template into Graincrawl?
rationale: The patch is technically clean and useful, but `.github` is explicitly code-owned and the author is a repository member, so final acceptance belongs to the designated human owner rather than cleanup automation.

options.title: Approve and merge
options.body: Confirm the canonical source and content hash, then land the focused metadata-only template addition.

options.title: Request repository-specific edits
options.body: Keep the PR open and request only the Graincrawl-specific wording changes the code owner considers necessary.

recommendation.title: Approve and merge
recommendation.body: Confirm the canonical source and content hash, then land the focused metadata-only template addition.
